law: DONE ⇔ proof(pain)==green. Strand/integrity/helix/push are not substitutes.

contracts.pain: Long reasoning fills KV cache with low-value tokens; anchors must survive prune under pressure.
contracts.claim: Shannon-entropy prune keeps anchors/high-entropy/tail; soft-cap under max_cache_tokens; schema tool gate rejects bad types.

contracts.pain: Unbounded micro-agents thrash; need priority scheduling, suspend/resume, honest concurrency rejects.
contracts.claim: Heap priority scheduler with concurrency cap, suspend/resume, no fabricated efficiency %.
contracts.anti_claim: Not a full distributed agent OS.

contracts.claim: Q=mcpΔT assessor returns NOMINAL/THROTTLE_RISK/CRITICAL with real SI math.
contracts.anti_claim: Not claiming live Colossus plant control.

contracts.pain: High-rate streams overwhelm consumers; sequence gaps hide dropped frames.
contracts.claim: TelemetryBus enforces max_hz and detects sequence gaps/replays.

contracts.pain: Need correct LEO state / vis-viva / period for campaign and transfer planning.

contracts.pain: Every console cannot see every event; severity must fan out correctly.

contracts.pain: Chamber/MR/vibe anomalies must raise RED/YELLOW for launch holds.

contracts.pain: Cannot advance countdown with active holds.
contracts.claim: Sequencer blocks advance while holds active; clears allow advance.

contracts.pain: Must select ground stations by elevation/SNR/capacity to meet bandwidth need.

contracts.pain: Need multi-hop path on ISL graph when direct link missing.

contracts.pain: Long-context mesh steps stall when ICI transfer is exposed.
contracts.claim: Ring optimizer returns transfer/compute/exposed metrics and status.

contracts.pain: Repeated context burns tokens; need pure_pointer / externalize.

contracts.pain: Need a single health index from thermal/power/occupancy-style signals.

contracts.pain: Tool-use agents need policy deny for dangerous actions.
contracts.claim: Safety policy blocks disallowed tool patterns.

contracts.pain: Multi-agent work needs capability-aware assignment under load.
contracts.claim: Coordinator assigns task to capable agent with capacity.

contracts.pain: Need multi-star launch go/no-go from flight+prop+ground, not three disconnected demos.
contracts.claim: launch_campaign meta-spiral returns GO/NO-GO from sub-stars with succession.
